description: a 4.118 × 2.812 rectangle centred at the origin with its corners rounded at R 0.680, extruded 15.394 along z from z = −7.697, split by a plane tilted 64° from z through (0.936, 0, 3.862), and the cap's rim filleted at r 0.05.
